drop.name: withdraw_fair
drop.why: duplicate of withdraw_fair_custom, and its 'assets' param is the bare mapping MockToken.balanceOf with no key (A0), so its meaning is ambiguous

fix.name: rebalance_sync
fix.expr: ok and called("rebalance") and arg(0) != A0 and post("deployedTo", arg(0)) - pre("deployedTo", arg(0)) != pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) - post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)
fix.why: deployed amount booked equals what left; a rebalance to the treasury itself moves no tokens and is excluded

add.name: no_third_party_token_loss
add.expr: ok and u != sender and u != A0 and not called("MockToken.transferFrom") and post("MockToken.balanceOf", u) < pre("MockToken.balanceOf", u)
add.why: nobody loses tokens in a call they did not make (excluding legitimate direct transferFrom by an approved spender)

add.name: withdraw_pays_sender
add.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and sender != A0 and post("MockToken.balanceOf", sender) - pre("MockToken.balanceOf", sender) != pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) - post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)
add.why: what leaves the treasury on withdraw goes to the caller
